dos.text: Call the button's own click() method (it just forwards to buttonEl.click()) rather than dispatching synthetic events at the host, since that's the only interaction API MozBoxButton exposes.

donts.text: Don't assume the built-in arrow-right.svg chevron means the component navigates anywhere on its own, MozBoxButton renders it unconditionally to match its "navigating between sub-pages" JSDoc framing but has no href or default click handler, so you must wire up navigation yourself.
